name: Lich Lord Sanguis

facts.text: Level 81, 100,000 health. Rises six seconds after Lord Sanguis dies; at 5% health he becomes almost untouchable 'in his last act of agony'.

story: What stands up out of the red floor is what Sanguis really is: the debt with no man left around it. Lich Lord Sanguis remembers every death he has died and resents each of them. He fights as though he has nothing to lose, which is true, and when the end comes for him at last he clings to the world with everything he has bought, and for a few moments almost nothing can reach him. Then the debt is paid, and the chapel floor is only stone.
legend: Right after Lord Sanguis. Burn him hard, and when he drops to the last sliver he goes nearly immune for a while; keep hitting and keep healing, it ends. Do not let the casters think it is over and wander off.

phases.text: No... I paid... I paid for this life!

lairEntry: The floor is red. It has been red a long time.

phases.text: Sanguis clings to his stolen life!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The blood-debt of Sanguis is paid. The floor is stone.

briefing: lich sanguis goes almost immune at 5%. keep hitting, it wears off
aftermathWin: the floor stopped being red. creepy
aftermathLoss: people stopped at 5% thinking he was bugged. he wasnt
rumour: heard lich lord sanguis gets almost unkillable at the very end
[someone said|heard] you kill sanguis twice in caer sidi

loremasterTopic.text: What rises from the red floor when Lord Sanguis falls: the debt with no man left around it. At the very end he clings to his stolen years and almost nothing touches him. Keep striking.

chronicle.win: {realm}'s raid under {raidLeader} paid off the blood-debt of Sanguis for good in {minutes} minutes.
